verdict.rationale: Docusign has a mature REST API and OpenAPI spec covering core eSignature actions (send/sign/manage envelopes, templates, embedded signing), and developer docs are described as thorough by some users. However, evidence pack shows core UI-first AI features (AI-Assisted Review, CLM drag-and-drop workflows, Iris-powered web forms) are documented only as UI capabilities with no corresponding API/SDK exposure, and community reports document real API gaps/security workarounds in embedded flows plus mixed integration experiences. Missing for 10: explicit API/SDK endpoints for AI-Assisted Review, CLM, and Web Forms builder; independent confirmation that all UI actions map 1:1 to API calls; resolution of documented embedded-signing security/API limitation.
